Jordan (People Ops): hey all :wave: quick security onboarding heads-up for folks who started this week — please run through the minimal checklist today if you haven't: 1) Security Essentials training 2) enroll your laptop in our MDM 3) enable disk encryption 4) complete the phishing sim when you get the invite. Phishing sim is scheduled for tomorrow 10:00am PT for new hires. Training (SSO) -> https://training.redwood.com/security-essentials. If you want to avoid company MDM on a personal device, DM me or @Kira. Ping IT Helpdesk for enrollment issues.

Kira - InfoSec: +1 Jordan. A few notes: the phishing sim is a learning exercise — if you click the test link we'll send a short coaching email and assign a 15-min micro-training, no disciplinary action. Everyone must finish the Security Essentials course by EOW (end of week). MDM enrollment link: https://mdm.redwood.com/enroll. For Mac you can check FileVault status with `fdesetup status`. For Windows check BitLocker with `manage-bde -status`.

Maya Li: Quick q — I'm on a personal Mac, I don't want Redwood controlling my whole laptop. What does MDM actually install/manage? :confused:

Kira - InfoSec: Good question. For BYOD we offer a "work profile" option where we only push a minimal profile: VPN config, certs, device encryption requirement, and an agent to enforce passcode/encryption. We do NOT install corporate apps or read personal files. Remote wipe is limited to company-managed devices; for BYOD we can do container wipe only. If you'd prefer a company laptop, People Ops can discuss a swap. DM me and Jordan and we'll sort.

Sam Ortiz: I signed up but I don't see the training in my LMS dashboard — no email invite yet.

Jordan (People Ops): sending invite now, Sam. Also double-check spam. Re-sent training link to Sam.O@redwood.com.

security-bot: Training assigned -> Sam Ortiz: "Security Essentials" (course id 502). Due: 2026-03-28.

IT Helpdesk: Hi @Maya Li — to enroll your Mac: 1) go to https://mdm.redwood.com/enroll and sign in with SSO 2) download the profile and open System Settings -> Profiles to install 3) post-install, confirm encryption: open Terminal and run `fdesetup status` (should return "FileVault is On"). Windows steps: open an elevated cmd and run `manage-bde -status` to confirm BitLocker. If enrollment fails, DM us or email it_help@redwood.com or join #help-it and we'll remote assist.

Maya Li: thanks — appreciate the BYOD clarification. I'll DM Jordan about a swap if needed.

Sam Ortiz: got the invite now, starting the training. :thumbsup:

Jordan (People Ops): thanks folks — reaching out if any follow-ups. Heads-up: phishing sim results are tracked to user accounts only for training metrics; managers see aggregate completion. :lock:

Kira - InfoSec: If anyone wants to preview the micro-training content before the sim, ping me and I'll drop the deck.
